createDocument.purpose: Create one blank live Word document and establish the Document Binding.
createDocument.verification: Prove the exact object returned by create is live, unsaved, Lease-bound, and committed before success becomes observable.
prerequisites: Document Intent is resolved for this Word Action.
The Word Task is UNBOUND.
constraints: Creates one blank unsaved document and never accepts a path.
Binding and Lease commit before a successful response is observable.

openDocument.purpose: Open or reuse one exact user-identified existing .docx and establish the Document Binding.
openDocument.verification: Prove stable file identity, exact open-or-reused object, observed .docx artifact/state, and atomic Binding plus Lease. Fingerprint observation must not change the document persistence state.
prerequisites: Document Intent is resolved for this Word Action.
The Word Task is UNBOUND.
constraints: The path is an absolute existing .docx resolved by stable identity.
Active UI state, display name, and open order never select the document.
Document observation preserves its saved/modified state; no hidden save or reset.

writeContent.purpose: Insert structured body content at an explicit body anchor.
writeContent.verification: Read back inserted text, block structure, semantic headings, and every explicitly supplied format field at the fresh range.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Blocks are either one inline text block or a paragraph/heading sequence.
fontFamily is a unified setting and cannot be mixed in one run with westernFontFamily or eastAsiaFontFamily.
All limits, revision, bounds, alignment, and protection checks precede writing.

inspectDocument.purpose: Return one revision-coherent normalized snapshot of bound Word body content, structure, layout, and document state.
inspectDocument.verification: Take all body, section, layout, header/footer, and persistence facts from one coherent revision without changing persistence state; never return mixed snapshots. Live header/footer text comes from the in-memory document XML, including unsaved changes.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Every returned fact belongs to one coherent Content Revision.
Body output may be bounded, but section/layout/header-footer facts never truncate.
Header/footer observation reads live in-memory XML without materializing COM stories.

findContent.purpose: Find bounded, literal, non-overlapping body-text matches against one coherent content revision.
findContent.verification: Return document-order non-overlapping observed literals and ranges from one revision; an empty match list is success.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Search is literal, bounded, non-wrapping, and non-overlapping.
All matches and remaining range belong to one Content Revision.

replaceContent.purpose: Replace one exact range or an explicitly counted literal query result with preflighted structured content.
replaceContent.verification: Preflight all targets and counts before the first write, mutate from the end, then read back every final fresh range.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: All targets and expected match counts are preflighted before the first write.
Multi-match replacement executes from document end toward start and is never replayed.

insertTable.purpose: Insert one non-empty rectangular plain-text table at an explicit body anchor.
insertTable.verification: Read back exact dimensions, repeating-header state, range, and normalized text from every created cell.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Data is a non-empty rectangular plain-text matrix within hard ceilings.
Success uses read-back cell data rather than request echo.

insertImage.purpose: Validate and embed one PNG or JPEG at an explicit body anchor with explicit placement, size, and alternative text.
insertImage.verification: Read back embedded media hash/type, dimensions, exact anchor, placement, wrap, and alternative text before success.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Only staged embedded PNG/JPEG files are accepted; URLs and links are forbidden.
Success reads back media hash, dimensions, placement, anchor, and alternative text.

setHeaderFooter.purpose: Apply explicit header/footer operations to revision-bound sections and read back every touched story.
setHeaderFooter.verification: Preflight every section/update, then read back enabled flags, link state, existence, and normalized text in stable order.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Section selection is revision-bound and update area/variant pairs are unique.
linkToPrevious never targets section 0; selecting all sections therefore forbids it.
All selected stories are preflighted before any write and read back after mutation.

setPageLayout.purpose: Apply explicit orientation and complete margin changes to revision-bound sections.
setPageLayout.verification: Preflight all section dimensions, then read back normalized orientation and all four margins for every selected section.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: At least one layout field is explicit and a margin object always contains all four sides.
All selected sections are preflighted and observed in normalized points.

insertBreak.purpose: Insert one explicit page or section break at a collapsed body anchor and verify the resulting structure.
insertBreak.verification: Use a duplicated collapsed range, then read back the page marker or exact section count/start type at a fresh revision.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: The handler duplicates and collapses the Body Anchor before insertion.
Only page and explicit section break types are supported and read back.

save.purpose: Persist the bound .docx through its existing locator and verify the saved artifact.
save.verification: Prove the same backing identity, saved state, .docx format, ordinary non-empty artifact, and live exact Binding.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Uses only the Binding's existing .docx locator and accepts no path.
An already-saved document may succeed only after the same artifact verification.

saveAs.purpose: Persist the bound live document as .docx at one explicit user-authorized output locator.
saveAs.verification: Prove explicit .docx format, artifact, saved state, same live document, destination identity, and gap-free Lease migration.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Output is fixed .docx and never overwrites. renameIfExists tries the requested name then numbered siblings within the same Action (at most 20 attempts).
Only definite pre-write name conflicts retry; unknown outcomes, permission errors and exhausted names stop. Read the actual artifact.path and outputResolution.
The same live document remains bound while destination Lease migration has no gap.

exportPdf.purpose: Export the complete bound Word document to one explicit user-authorized PDF artifact.
exportPdf.verification: Prove a non-empty readable PDF for one stable content revision without saving, retargeting, or changing the Word Binding.
prerequisites: The Word Task has one exact live Word Document Binding.
The bound document and controller remain provably usable.
constraints: Exports the complete document to PDF without saving or retargeting the Word document.
renameIfExists retries only definite name conflicts against numbered siblings (at most 20 attempts); it never overwrites or retries unknown effects. Read artifact.path and outputResolution.
Success proves one readable artifact while revision and document state remain unchanged.
